 BREAKING: Everything we know about the Spartanburg Water outage Closings and Delays $2 million Upstate lottery winner looks to help others 
 An Upstate lottery winner plans to spread some joy this holiday season. By Mary Kate Howland Published : Nov. 17, 2026 at 11:30 AM EST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google SPARTANBURG COUNTY, S.C. (FOX Carolina) - An Upstate lottery winner plans to spread some joy this holiday season.
 Officials said the winner, who wishes to be anonymous, won $2 million on a $20 scratch-off at the KC Mart #8 on Highway 9 in Boiling Springs.
 “I still don’t really believe it,” the winner told South Carolina Education Lottery officials. “It’s life-changing for me. And it’s wonderful to be able to make some donations to charities that will help others.”
 According to officials, the ticket overcame odds of more than 1 in 1,500,000 to leave two more top prizes of $2 million remaining in the Ultimate Millions game.
